steps.text: Go to Shadowthorn, the elf town in the swamp south-east of Venore.
steps.source: First, you need to make your way to Shadowthorn in the swamps south-east of Venore.

steps.text: Go down the ladder closest to you (elves).
steps.source: You will encounter some Elves. Go down the ladder closest to you.

steps.text: In the barrel: a heaven blossom (elves here, maybe a lured elf overseer).
steps.source: Make your way towards the star on the map. You will only encounter some Elves here. Open the Barrel to receive your reward, a Heaven Blossom.
